fee.value: There is no application fee for international first-year applicants using the Common Application.

evidence.quote: There is no fee to apply for admission to Connecticut College.

testing.value: SAT or ACT results are optional in the international first-year checklist. English-proficiency evidence is a separate requirement.

evidence.quote: *Optional* Results of the SAT Reasoning Test or ACT

fee.value: No application fee for international applicants using the Common Application, Coalition Application or Knox College Application.

evidence.quote: There is no application fee.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international applicants. National examinations such as GCE, IGCSE, IB or A-level results still accompany the transcript when applicable.

evidence.quote: Knox does not require the SAT or ACT to apply

aid.value: Knox offers scholarships but does not offer need-based aid to international students. All applicants submit an Affidavit of Support proving sufficient funding. Need-aware admission is stated separately on the international application page; do not interpret a scholarship as full cost coverage.

evidence.quote: Knox does not offer need-based aid to international students.

fee.value: DePauw does not charge an application fee for international undergraduate applicants.

evidence.quote: DePauw University does not charge an application fee and is test-optional.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international admission. Test-optional applicants are still considered for merit scholarships. English proficiency is separate.

evidence.quote: Test-optional applicants are still considered for merit-based scholarships.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international admission. English-proficiency documentation for admission and I-20 preparation is separate and must not be confused with test-optional admission.

evidence.quote: Earlham is test score optional regarding the SAT and ACT.

aid.value: International applicants may receive merit scholarships and institutional grants, but housing, food and other costs are not covered by these awards. The current page states a minimum first-year contribution of $25,000 for non-UWC international families, increasing with attendance costs. UWC graduates have separate funding arrangements. Confirm the contribution for your entry year with admissions.

evidence.quote: Earlham does not award scholarships or grants for housing, food and other costs

fee.value: No application fee for international first-year applicants, including Early Decision and Regular Decision.

evidence.quote: There is no application fee for any option.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for first-year admission. This does not waive separate English-proficiency requirements.

evidence.quote: we’re a test-optional institution

fee.value: No application fee for undergraduate admission to Bard College. Graduate and other Bard institutions have separate policies.

evidence.quote: There is no application fee to apply to Bard College

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international undergraduate applicants. Not submitting scores does not penalize an application; English testing is separate.

evidence.quote: You do not need to take the SAT or ACT to apply to Bard.

english.value: International applicants whose primary language is not English submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. Current score guidelines: TOEFL 5 on the new scale (100 on the previous scale), IELTS 7, DET 120. A waiver can be requested after three recent years of secondary education fully in English, an English-primary home country, or case-by-case circumstances. Approval through the applicant portal is required.

evidence.quote: All international applicants for whom English is not their primary language must submit one of the approved English proficiency tests.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international applicants, as are interviews and artistic supplements.

evidence.quote: Standardized tests (such as the ACT and SAT), interviews, and artistic supplements are optional.

english.value: Applicants whose first language is not English and who have not studied in an English-language curriculum for the past four years should submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. Competitive scores (not stated as universal minimums): TOEFL 100 before January 21, 2026, or 5–5.5 afterwards; IELTS 7+; DET 130+. Extensions may be requested for hardship.

evidence.quote: Applicants for whom English is not their first language and who have not studied in an English language curriculum for the past four years

fee.value: Reed has waived application fees for applicants.

evidence.quote: we've waived application fees and embraced a test-free policy for applicants.

testing.value: Reed describes its admission policy as test-free. SAT/ACT are not required; separate English requirements remain under review.

evidence.quote: embraced a test-free policy for applicants.

aid.value: International admission is need-aware. Need-based aid is limited and merit scholarships are available. Applicants requesting need-based aid submit the CSS Profile and all international applicants submit Certification of Finances. Mandatory insurance and one-time fees are excluded from international aid; do not assume full cost coverage.

evidence.quote: Dickinson College is need-aware in the admission of international students

testing.value: SAT/ACT are optional for international first-year applicants. Scores may be submitted if desired.

evidence.quote: Dickinson has been test optional since 1994, so applicants may submit their tests scores if desired.

english.value: Applicants whose first language is not English must demonstrate proficiency: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo are accepted. Recommended scores: TOEFL 90 on the old scale or 4.5 after January 2026; IELTS 7; DET 120. At least three years of high-school coursework in standard English (not ESL) is an alternative; modern-language courses are excepted.

evidence.quote: Applicants whose first language is other than English must demonstrate their English proficiency to be considered for admission.

testing.value: SAT/ACT are strongly recommended on the international page but are not required. Self-reported scores can be submitted and are verified upon enrollment. English-proficiency requirements are separate.

evidence.quote: SAT or ACT scores may be submitted as self-reported or official scores, but are not required.

deadline.value: The same international page lists January 20 for ED II applications but January 15 for the ED II agreement form. Confirm the deadline with admissions before applying.

evidence.quote: Early Decision II: January 20

testing.value: Beloit is test-optional. Applicants may send SAT/ACT scores if they want them considered; separate English-proficiency requirements still apply.

evidence.quote: Beloit is test-optional.

testing.value: SAT/ACT scores are not required for admission or scholarship consideration. Conservatory auditions and English requirements are separate.

evidence.quote: ACT or SAT test scores are not required for admission or scholarship consideration.
